analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 지속. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 시도 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 아직 추세 전환 신호는 미약. ADX 22.8로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 확정은 이르다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.19로 움직임에 힘이 실리지 않은 상태. 스윙 지지선 189,200원, 저항선 209,000원 사이에서의 횡보 구간 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI attempted to exit oversold territory and is now consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but lacks a strong trend reversal signal. ADX at 22.8 indicates an early stage of trend formation, making directional confirmation premature. Volume ratio at 1.19 against the 5-day average suggests a lack of conviction in price movement. The stock remains within the consolidation range between the swing support at 189,200 KRW and resistance at 209,000 KRW.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (194,700 KRW) vs SMA5 (199,160 KRW) / SMA20 (210,565 KRW) / SMA50 (235,915 KRW): below short-term, below mid-term, below long-term
· Position relative to SMA100 (249,565 KRW) / SMA200 (237,599 KRW): below long-term trend, weak zone
· 52-week position (35.8%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.0→38.9): exiting oversold, continuing in neutral zone, turning downwards
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1316.7377→-328.3230): improving, consolidating in weak zone
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Middle Band 210,565 KRW): consolidating near the middle band, bandwidth at 27.95% indicating moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (189,200 KRW): higher level compared to 52-week low (94,500 KRW)
· Swing Resistance (209,000 KRW): below 5-day high (216,000 KRW), potential for upward reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: attempting Higher Low (5-day low 188,800 KRW > 20-day low 179,200 KRW), forming Lower High (5-day high 216,000 KRW < 20-day high 249,000 KRW)
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.19x): moderate confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI exiting oversold and consolidating in neutral zone, ADX shows no trend, maintaining wait-and-see conditions
